task.title: Expand performance fixtures and resource coverage
task.description:
Extend the acceptance harness beyond its current scalar-only fixture and aggregate Git storage totals. Generated 500-by-20 histories should exercise realistic description sizes, labels, dependency edges, ranks, and a controlled tombstone population while remaining deterministic and semantically valid.

Add the missing many-changed projection refresh scenario; separate operation-blob, state-blob, commit/tree, SQLite projection, and validation-cache storage; capture peak RSS and I/O for projection rebuild and full validation; make repository scenarios honor the requested sample count; and measure independent task-count and history-depth slopes at 100/500/1,000 tasks and 20/100 operations where practical. Keep setup outside measured commands and retain SHA-1/SHA-256 coverage.

Acceptance: reports distinguish target-bearing latency scenarios from descriptive resource metrics, include fixture-shape metadata, and make it possible to tell whether cost scales with task count, history depth, payload size, or cache size without changing Workbook durability behavior.
